hypothesis: Positions that first move far enough in our favor but fail to hit fixed targets leak alpha through giveback; a full-position ATR trailing exit may improve old_thin without changing entries, sizing, candidate universe, or LLM/news behavior.
why_not_llm_or_sec: LLM soft-ranking and SEC/filing samples remain coverage-limited; this uses replayable OHLCV path data already available in all three canonical snapshots.

market_regime_summary.mid_weak: rotation-heavy bull where strategy makes money but lags indexes
market_regime_summary.old_thin: mixed-to-weak older tape with lower win rate

gate4_basis: Rejected because no full-position ATR trailing profile cleared the fixed three-window Gate 4 acceptance bar.

production_impact.promotion_requirement: A positive variant cannot be merged as strategy logic until the same exit action is surfaced by run.py through shared production policy.

rejection_reason: Full ATR trailing either cut fixed-target winners or did not reduce giveback enough across a majority of windows.
next_retry_requires: Do not repeat nearby ATR trigger/offset sweeps without a richer discriminator.
A valid retry needs event/news context or a position-state feature that separates real trend exhaustion from normal volatility.
If promoted later, implement through shared production parity rather than backtester-only config.
